This '''[[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]]''' was flown by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] just prior to the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].

==History==
Kenobi flew this starfighter to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] under the pretense of needing to refuel it. After he was informed of the situation by [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]], [[Chairman of Utapau/Legends|Port Administrator]] of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], Kenobi ordered [[R4-G9/Legends|R4-G9]] to fly the ship back to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces and inform the clones of the circumstances, while he stayed in Pau City to engage [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
